name: components/date-time-picker
description: A standalone datetime picker built on Ark UI date-picker primitives, combining calendar selection with integrated hour/minute controls. Supports single and range datetime modes, 12h/24h display, configurable minute stepping, inline and popover rendering, and locale-aware formatting.
useCases: Schedule creation flows requiring exact start date and time selection
Analytics filters that compare datetime ranges for reports
Booking and reservation forms with date and clock precision
Workflow automation forms requiring 12h and 24h entry variants
